title: 🗳️ general election — 2nd turn
body:
# 🧭 Steps

1. If no majority in the 1st turn, vote in the runoff (president / governor) — expect **25 Oct 2026**; confirm the official date. If no 2nd turn is needed, mark done and disable.
2. Follow [the voting routine](./election/voting.md) — e-Titulo, in-person vote, or justificativa.

## ✅ Done when

- Voted in 2nd turn, or justified absence, or confirmed no 2nd turn needed
- Deadline bumped to next cycle (2030-10-25)
